apps.name: 001 Game Creator
apps.short_description: 001 Game Creator is a Graphically Assisted Scripting engine for beginners and advanced users alike by SoftWeir. Developers can quickly prototype ideas, test complex systems and build single player and online/local multiplayer experiences for Windows PC, Steam Deck, HTML5, and natively Android/iOS.

apps.name: Desktop Engine
apps.short_description: Bring interactive 3D companions to your Windows desktop. Choose an official character or import your own model, arrange them around your windows, and enjoy animations and optional voice reactions with adjustable volume.

apps.name: Earthframe Studio
apps.short_description: Try the demo before you buy. Create spectacular photorealistic images and videos of planet Earth in minutes with an intuitive, easy-to-use tool. Set the sun, clouds, city lights and atmosphere, animate with two keyframes and render stills up to 16K or MP4 and ProRes video.

apps.name: NeuralBeat Studio
apps.short_description: Cross-feature procedural & AI-assisted creation for music, audio, voice, dialogue, and FX mixing. Practical manual control with a 100% local-first privacy architecture. Built for fast iteration and production-ready export for games, video, and interactive media

apps.name: Pocket Chief!
apps.short_description: Pocket Chief! is an AI companion who lives in the corner of your desktop. She remembers what you’ve been working on.

apps.name: Pronoisseur
apps.short_description: Turn your monitors into a video wall. Pronoisseur plays and organises your own video collection: a fast searchable library, multi-monitor walls you compose and save, per-tile colour grading and smooth 4K playback. Local and private, with no account and no cloud.

apps.name: Sidekick AI
apps.short_description: A real-time anime sidekick who watches your game, voice-chats tips when you ask, and clips your best moments — all in-overlay, never alt-tab. Stream-safe, free to play.

apps.name: Simulator.Company
apps.short_description: Simulator.company enables you to create a Digital Twin of a company and combine all software and hardware, employees, customers, and the processes that are happening between them in the metaverse, transforming a business into the Software-defined company.

公路求生：折叠空间 ( 3947270 ) Playtest

Get the 007 First Light Free Starter Pack, and step into the world of espionage for FREE.

Experience the opening chapter in Iceland, and discover the beginnings of this re-imagined origin story of James Bond.

apps.name: 52Beatup Demo
apps.short_description: The Demo for 52Beatup: A Deck Building Fighting Game. 5 Playable Characters, Fully Functional Tutorial/Training mode, and more!

apps.name: A Little Age Demo
apps.short_description: A cozy minimalist city builder about expanding a network of settlements, each with its own little economy. Manage the flow of resources between them at your own pace, and pause at any time. Watch a civilization emerge as your settlements work together to raise a great temple and claim the land.

apps.name: AMERICAN LIFE SIMULATOR Demo
apps.short_description: Start your own lawn care business, buy houses, rent out your properties, and live the American Dream in an open-world neighborhood life simulator.

apps.name: Ancient World Demo
apps.short_description: Try the Ancient World demo, a story-driven survival adventure set in an open desert. Gather resources, craft tools, explore ancient ruins, fight goblins, and begin your search for your missing sister in a world full of danger and mystery.

apps.name: Athelan Battlegrounds Demo
apps.short_description: Athelan Battlegrounds is a turn-based, tactics PvP game for those who care about player skill above all. Join intergalactic champions in a retro-futuristic arena as they fight for the fate of their planets against contenders from across the cosmos. Every choice matters, and the winner takes all!

apps.name: Aye Aye Captain Demo
apps.short_description: Welcome aboard, mateys! Aye Aye Captain is a chaotic co-op pirate game for one to four players. Working as a team, you and your fellow crews must prepare your cannons, clean and repair your pirate ship, fight with abreast enemies and avoid hitting the bottom of the sea

apps.name: Boss, I Crashed! - Depot Tycoon Demo
apps.short_description: You run a depot. Your drivers run into everything else. Ship pallets across a 3D tabletop map, manage drivers with too many excuses, outplay a rival depot and watch your own disasters on the evening news. Then read the Z report and cry.

apps.name: Captive 3000 Demo
apps.short_description: Wake from cryosleep on a dying space station prison and guide a remote droid to your own rescue. A lightning-fast, real-time, grid-based dungeon crawler with traditional sprite design. Explore and fight through 50+ hours of handcrafted star bases, then infinite seeded missions. Free demo available.

apps.name: Cruise Control Demo
apps.short_description: Manage a cruise ship in this time-management strategy game! Build the dream cruise experience for your guests, work fast to solve problems, keep up with demand, upgrade your offerings to make every voyage even better, and keep the chaos from going overboard!

apps.name: Feedmaster Demo
apps.short_description: Feedmaster is a strategy game about recommendations. Study users’ interests and emotions, turn creators, ads, and ideas into posts they’ll like, then combine users, tags, and traits to meet rising weekly goals and convert clicks. Where users—and the world—end up is something to worry about later.

apps.name: Flick Demo
apps.short_description: Flick light switches on and off throughout a long-abandoned house to shift the environment from a safe reality to a blood-soaked echo where grisly puzzles manifest. A psychological horror experience where you must balance the light you need to progress with the terrifying nightmares it summons.

apps.name: Follyvale Demo
apps.short_description: The demo of a wordless hidden-object puzzle game set inside living medieval paintings. Find what the villagers need, carry it across the scene and set their troubles right, and each one you mend brings the picture into full colour. No timers, no way to fail, and the Fool to help or get in your way.

apps.name: Fortune Avenue Demo
apps.short_description: A competitive board game where players vote to shape their destiny. Transform caravans into 5-star hotels, collect wonders, and earn bounties for bankrupting opponents. Use airports to outmaneuver rivals, organize World Cups to multiply your rent. Can you turn your empire into a global monopoly?

apps.name: Foundlings Demo
apps.short_description: Guide two troubled mages through a civil war-torn 12th-century England in this spellcasting RPG. Level up your Liberal Arts, forge spells by combining conduits and watch the motions of the planets. The demo contains the prologue to Foundlings, exploring young Agnes's relationship with her Master.

apps.name: Galactic Disharmony Demo
apps.short_description: A Sci-fi First-person shooter and Strategy game. Command and control your fleets and planets, build troops and extract resources in the solar maps' turn-based strategic mode. Then head into battle with your troops in large-scale first-person warfare to conquer planets.

apps.name: Gods to Dust Demo
apps.short_description: The whole First Hour, free: six gates, four expeditions and nine boss fights across the Red Sands, ending at the Sealed Gate. Choose your weapon, walk the Night Wheel, and see how long the night lets you last.

apps.name: High Wizards Demo
apps.short_description: A chaotic first-person co-op roguelite for 1 to 8 players. Play as a floating wizard head: fire spells from your finger gun, stack modifiers into absurd wand combos, hit your weed pen to get blazed, and survive two lands that loop back harder every time. Free demo with its own leaderboards.

apps.name: IntoTheLibrary Demo
apps.short_description: Explore an ever-changing library and seal away demons. Combine characters, skills, equipment, and artifacts to forge your own playstyle in this action roguelite.

apps.name: Iron Dice Demo
apps.short_description: Play a complete Iron Dice campaign for free. Learn the game through the full tutorial, then choose from 19 kingdoms on the 201-province Anvil map and lead your realm across the full 100-year campaign horizon.

apps.name: Island Shuffle Demo
apps.short_description: Build, combine, and unwind on colorful islands. Try several relaxed levels in one island theme in this demo.

apps.name: Kitman Demo
apps.short_description: KITMAN is a 1-4 player job simulator set in the backrooms of a football stadium. Run the team by running the locker room. Clean the team’s boots, patch jerseys, mop floors, and when no-one is looking… sneak into the gaffer’s office and fix the game plan!

apps.name: Mycelium Conquest Demo
apps.short_description: A deep biological network automation game where you grow a living mycelial network across an alien planet. Consume the local flora and creatures, build biological production chains, and evolve from a tiny spore into a cosmic entity that consumes worlds.

apps.name: Nebula Blink Demo
apps.short_description: Real-time space-fleet tactics where formation, facing and weapon arcs decide every engagement. Command 35 operations from both sides of a galactic war.

apps.name: NOSTRA Demo
apps.short_description: Play the opening hours of NOSTRA, a dark fantasy RPG with side-view party combat. Explore Grünthal and the woods beyond, parry on the frame, break guards with Boost and face what waits beneath the bandit camp. This alpha demo grows with every update until release.

apps.name: Operation Crimson Demo
apps.short_description: A story-driven top-down action shooter. Venture into hazardous zones consumed by a biological catastrophe, battle mutated creatures of all shapes and sizes with firearms and melee weapons, and gradually uncover the truth behind the disaster as you advance through tense, tightly paced linear levels.

apps.name: PAPERWORKS: Paper Shredder Inc. Demo
apps.short_description: Scan books, shred the originals, and burn humanity's knowledge for cash in this first-person incremental game. Upgrade machines and automate your work—but why is the office empty, and who's giving orders through the terminals? Uncover the conspiracy before humanity burns.

apps.name: Price for Freedom: Gold and Sand Demo
apps.short_description: Gold and Sand is an erotic-CRPG with turn-based combat. Beautiful hand drawn art elevates this character driven game where you will explore the unique world and guide characters as they discover each other and themselves in fully animated erotic scenes.

apps.name: Professional Ship Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Take the helm in this realistic, large-scale maritime simulation. Command your fleet from agile rescue vessels to massive LNG tankers and perform precise maneuvers in challenging conditions. Navigate a living open world where weather, traffic, and every wave shape your career.

apps.name: Room Movers Demo
apps.short_description: Grab one end, I'll take the other. A cozy game about unboxing and arranging tiny diorama rooms, with a friend or on your own. No grid, no score, no timer. Just you, your friend, and a room that slowly becomes a place.

apps.name: SHRED A BILLION Demo
apps.short_description: SHRED A BILLION is a first-person incremental game about a mountain of money! Grab bills by hand, scoop them up with a bucket, level up and feed a billion dollars to the shredder. Only 3,929,120,202 bills left to collect!

apps.name: Snack Invaders Demo
apps.short_description: Slipping into a junk food-induced coma during a late-night movie marathon, you wake up as an astronaut stranded in a galaxy overrun by living junk food! Play solo or co-op online with up to 3 friends (4 players max) to battle hordes of junk food and Souls-like bosses as you fight to escape alive!

apps.name: Sorcerous 2 City of Cults Demo
apps.short_description: Kick down doors, hunt sinister cults, and face bloodthirsty gods in a dark diesel-punk metropolis. Lead a group of magic-school students into turn-based battles with carefully chosen spells, talismans, and occult weapons.

apps.name: Stack Inspector Demo
apps.short_description: Try the free Stack Inspector demo! Stack awkward objects in first person, outsmart gravity and face MIRA’s watchful inspections. One bad move can bring everything down.

apps.name: Star Chasers Demo
apps.short_description: Star Chasers Demo is a 2–4 player local multiplayer party game! Roll the dice, race across the board, collect stars, and challenge your friends in wild mini-games. Dodge lasers, survive lava, and outplay your rivals with skill, strategy, and a little luck. Who will claim the party crown?

apps.name: Surviving Day! Demo
apps.short_description: Jump into an endless voxel world adventure. Mine for ores and cut down trees, marvel at your own creations that can be wired with computers and more! Enjoy the wild life and fend off bears that turn aggravated near by! Dragons and the rare velociraptor are also known to lurk in the world.

apps.name: Swarmdle Demo
apps.short_description: Swarmdle deals the same twelve minutes to every player on Earth. Same weapon, same map, same modifiers, same wave timeline. Survive the swarm, level up, and evolve your build. Share your results and find out whether your friends did better with the exact same draw.

apps.name: The Fate of Onexora Demo
apps.short_description: The Fate of Onexora is a turn-based, story rich RPG with a wide array of skills and equipment, allowing you to play in the style that suits you best. Discover a world full of secrets hidden behind ancestral conflicts.

apps.name: Tiny Fortress Demo
apps.short_description: [Previously called "Tiny Towers"] A short incremental game about defending your tiny fortress from hordes of tiny mobs. Place towers, gain resources by defeating enemies, and unlock new upgrades in the skill tree to strengthen your goblin stronghold.

apps.name: Trophy Rex Demo
apps.short_description: A retro first-person dinosaur hunting game. Stalk 31 species across 9 hunting grounds, read the wind, choose your rifle and place the shot that reaches the heart. Wounded prey bleeds, runs or charges. Fly your trophies home to the lodge, or die out there and lose them all.

apps.name: Twinkleby Demo
apps.short_description: Twinkleby is a cozy decoration game where you map out an archipelago of floating islands and build dioramas for a society of spacefaring neighbours. Try out a little piece of the upcoming game in this demo!

apps.name: Unboxing Demo
apps.short_description: UNBOXING Demo: Dive into this puzzle-platformer where death is your key to progress. In this free demo, solve 15+ challenging puzzles using your companion box to revive and navigate a strange, paradoxical world. Uncover the mystery of an endless cycle—can you break free?

apps.name: Unfinished Demo
apps.short_description: An abandoned commercial building. A forgotten incident. Something lurking in the ruins. Uncover the truth and escape in this first-person survival horror.

apps.name: ZOMBIE DESTROYER Demo
apps.short_description: Just dodge. Your guns do the shooting. Quick, punchy runs, then toss your cells into the incinerator and watch the coins pour out.

apps.name: いただきバーガー Demo
apps.short_description:
The demo for a physics-stacking burger roguelike deckbuilder.
Layers score off their neighbors and every layer adds up — but one greedy layer can bring the whole tower down.
The demo gives you three chefs and a four-customer shift.

apps.name: 我的恋爱逃生攻略 Love to Live Demo
apps.short_description: 《我的恋爱逃生计划》是一款乙女类视觉小说AVG。在游戏中，您将化作误入梦境游戏的新手玩家，在危机四伏的游戏副本中与三名男主角组队，携手闯关、相识相知、情感升温。游戏内有副本探索环节和大量的剧情选项分支，您需要在其中挖掘副本阴谋的真相，甚至揭开自己的身世之谜……

apps.short_description: "Evernight Without Calamity" is a pixel-art Daoist sim with story & management. Run your agency: make elixirs, draw charms, see through, expose ghosts. Your seal decides all fates. As last heir of Tianxuan, walk yin-yang, end a century-old curse, and find redemption with your chosen.

apps.short_description: Set out on an epic journey to Iowa! Explore the Hawkeye State as you drive along the iconic I-80 to the capital city of Des Moines and discover charming towns along the Mississippi River.

apps.short_description: Discover Aegyptus, build cities in its river delta, and use the floods to your advantage. If you can handle the local raider and get along with the new rival governor, this province offers many opportunities!

apps.name: Arma 3 Creator DLC: Western Sahara
apps.short_description: Train and operate as a military contractor, repel enemy forces with a variety of new weapons, rescue a kidnapped journalist, and race across sand dunes in the sweeping and immersive desert terrain of Sefrou-Ramal in the latest addition to Arma 3’s massive military sandbox.

apps.name: Arma 3 Malden
apps.short_description: Welcome back to Malden, soldier! This is where we started our amazing journey with the Arma franchise sixteen years ago. We hope you'll enjoy this re-imagination of Malden.

apps.short_description: An add-on for Endless Legend, the critically acclaimed 4X turn-based strategy game. Adds Irjsko Lasmak and Bayari Kulaa to cast of heroes. This content was unlocked to celebrate the Make War Not Love 4 community event.

apps.short_description: Expand your gaming experience with the new official extension for Farming Simulator 19! This DLC contains 2 new vehicles and 6 equipment from HOLMER, Annaburger and Zunhammer.

apps.short_description: Adds a costume for the Servant Saber.

apps.short_description: This is the Supporter Pack for "Path of Idle: Old Gods Rising" Thank you for your support!

apps.short_description: This pack contains 1 multi-faction weapon skin and 1 emote.

apps.name: Supermarket Simulator - Electronics DLC
apps.short_description: Power up your store with the new Electronics DLC! Expand your inventory with popular everyday tech essentials such as LED bulbs, power banks, USB chargers, flash drives, headphones, Bluetooth speakers, video doorbells, and many more.

apps.name: Swarmslam - Supporter Pack
apps.short_description: Support the developer of Swarmslam! Adds the Void's Shadow star chart theme, the Negative VOID look and a thank-you in the credits. Purely cosmetic: nothing in it affects gameplay.

apps.name: theHunter: Call of the Wild™ - Bearclaw Lite CB-60
Ukrainian Warfare: Gostomel Heroes - Unfinished Battle
apps.short_description: A DLC that adds a new game mode, "Battles," to the game.

apps.name: XCOM 2: Shen's Last Gift
apps.short_description: Investigate ADVENT’s “Lost Towers” facility where Chief Engineer Lily Shen accompanies your squad in search of her late father’s secretive final project. Discover a unique new soldier class complete with powerful new combat abilities, strategy mechanics, and customization options.

apps.name: A Game About Digging A Hole™ Together
apps.short_description: A minimalist game about digging a hole at the beach, now with friends. Dig together, collect resources, sell them, upgrade your equipment and search for a promised treasure buried deep beneath the sand.

apps.name: A Wizard-Chess Tournament
apps.short_description: Chess, but with wizards. Every piece has HP and Attack and spell cards bend the rules. Outplay a friend in hotseat, over LAN, or online and climb the leaderboard.

apps.name: Abduct & Destroy
apps.short_description: Pilot a UFO in a chaotic VR arcade game. Abduct humans, blast buildings apart, and take on ridiculous missions with your ship’s destruction and abduction cannons. Earth is having a very bad day.

apps.name: Abyss at Hand
apps.short_description: Form an adventuring party on your own or with friends, and set out to defeat this world’s Demon Lord! Abyss at Hand is a multiplayer action-adventure game for 1–4 players. Experience thrilling, adrenaline-pumping battles in a vast fantasy world!

apps.name: Am I Nima
apps.short_description: Am I Nima is a psychological-horror game where you must convince your mom that you really are her daughter. Combine words together in your brain and use them to talk. Get her to trust you.

apps.name: Andy Blast Vs The Forces of Evil
apps.short_description: A 2D Platforming Shotgun Extravaganza! Andy Blast Vs The Forces of Evil is a spiritual successor to Dangerous Dave in the Haunted Mansion! Return to the mansion and explore further as you take down the Forces of Evil to rescue Jeanette from the clutches of a mad scientist and his Forces of Evil!

apps.name: Anno Online
apps.short_description: Anno Online is a free-to-play city-builder game that lets you develop big magnificent metropolises in the medieval times.

apps.name: Ant Colony: Wild Forest
apps.short_description: Build and automate your own ant colony – a nest that runs itself! Freely dig and shape your underground kingdom, produce different types of ants, and grow it block by block. Then it's time for conquest: scale up your swarm, crush enemy bases, and lead your colony to victory in the wild forest!

apps.name: ArkSeed Terraformery
apps.short_description: You are the last chance for humanity, Terraform, Build, Save Humanity one pixel at a time. Arkseed Terraformery is a 2D factory and colony building and automation game with physics.

apps.name: Armed Prototype: Dual Blaze
apps.short_description: Armed Prototype: Dual Blaze is a pixel-art side-scrolling action shooter for solo or local co-op play! Run, jump and climb under fire. Smash special devices to switch between gun-wielding and sword-wielding heroines. Fight through enemy lines with bullets and blades—alone or with a friend!

apps.name: Axomorph Idle
apps.short_description: Axomorph Idle, an idle biogentics game about evolving an axolotl from a cell to an ultimate axolotl form. Journey through an idle adventure through growth, expansion, mutation, and transcendence stages. If you love numbers, or axolotls, this game might be it for you. Try it out today for free!

apps.name: Beast Bounty: Barricade!
apps.short_description: Build a solid defense line to protect a prize car in this physics-based building and defense game. Use a crane to stack containers, walls, and vehicles. You have two minutes and a limited budget before turrets and riflemen put your barricade to the test.

apps.name: Blazing Fighter King
apps.short_description: Blazing Fighter King is a chaotic stick-figure brawler for 2–4 players! Grab guns, swing swords, and battle across shaky platforms and tumbling crates. Dodge, snatch weapons, and use the terrain and surprise attacks to defeat your rivals and claim the title of Fighter King!

apps.name: Blazing Strike: R.Evolution
apps.short_description: The fight continues in Blazing Strike: R.Evolution. This handcrafted HD beat 'em up brings Jake and his gang back to the streets to face a new, darker threat. Featuring fluid sprite-based combat, a deep Story Mode, and classic arcade action—handcrafted for the ultimate brawl.

apps.name: Blind Route
apps.short_description: Blind cannot see the route; their teammates must describe it by voice. Communicate as Blind and Guide, survive dangerous 3D obstacle courses, and reach the finish before the rival team in solo, co-op, and competitive online modes.

apps.name: Blobby and the Milkshake
apps.short_description: An octopus stole your milkshake. Why? Who knows! Ride robot crabs, fly fire hydrants, sled in bathtubs, and fight power-hungry pirate clams in this goofy, open-ended 2D platformer. Explore dozens of levels, branch your path, and do whatever it takes to get your drink back.

apps.name: Boss, I Crashed! - Depot Tycoon
apps.short_description: You run a depot. Your drivers run into everything else. Ship pallets across a 3D tabletop map, manage drivers with too many excuses, outplay a rival depot and watch your own disasters on the evening news. Then read the Z report and cry.

apps.name: Bottom Farm
apps.short_description: A cozy idle village that lives at the bottom of your screen. Villagers farm, fish, chop wood and build on their own while you watch videos or work. At night, everyone comes together to protect the fields. Just peek down now and then and watch your little village grow.

apps.name: BrokenLore: DON'T PLAY
apps.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game where a mysterious experimental video game invades reality. Face five increasingly disturbing levels and survive their consequences as Hideo slips toward identity loss.

apps.name: Build More Tanks!
apps.short_description: Design tanks and defenses piece by piece, collect scrap, and deploy your creations to a multiplayer battlefield where Green and Blue fight for control. Destroy the enemy base, test new designs in Sandbox, or battle in Tank Arena.

apps.name: Bukchon Anomaly
apps.short_description: A first-person anomaly horror game on a looping street inspired by Seoul's Bukchon Hanok Village. You get one photo per passage. At the gate, report whether anything changed. Three wrong reports end your run, and some anomalies come for you before you get there.

apps.name: Butt Out!
apps.short_description: The neighbors are coming to drag you off the toilet. Feed the hero, combine foods, and aim a flexible pipe in this arcade wave defense game. Unlock new projectiles, stock up on food, build obstacles, and choose your upgrade path.

apps.name: Caravan Carnage: Fruity Road
apps.short_description:
Bad Fruits have taken over the Roads! Fight off waves of Fruits in this comedic chaotic side-scrolling shooter!
Deliver Cargo, Upgrade your Ride, Hire Defenders, and choose the right Gear to protect your Caravan and survive the Road ahead!

apps.name: ChemHex
apps.short_description: Crash-landed on a barren planet, you have one way home: chemistry. Fit real molecules onto hex grids in clever placement puzzles, meet the colony's oddball crew, and turn a barren rock into a living world, one reaction at a time.

apps.name: Christmas Workshop: Tidy Up Together
apps.short_description: The elves pulled an all nighter and the workshop is buried under a mountain of toys! Grab up to 7 friends, climb the pile and put thousands of teddies, trains and presents back where they belong before Santa's inspection. Cozy, chaotic, satisfying co-op.

apps.name: Clipmatrix
apps.short_description: Clipmatrix is a momentum platformer built on classic bhop physics. Slip past the fences of surreal industrial facilities to film illicit, high-speed runs. Just don't forget to press record.

apps.name: Color Parade
apps.short_description: Color Parade is a cheerful two-player co-op painting adventure! Play as a young painter and an adorable pup: spray paint, leave colorful pawprints, and bring a colorless world back to life. Explore vibrant themed maps, tackle painting challenges together, or face off in playful contests!

apps.name: Company of Heroes: Eastern Front
apps.short_description: Eastern Front is a free mod for Company of Heroes which has successfully added a full Soviet faction packed with unique and exciting units as well as the rugged Ostheer, a unique new Axis faction which was designed to counter the Soviets, a feat never before achieved in the Company of Heroes world.

apps.name: Corner Pocket: World Billiards
apps.short_description: Play eight billiards games online for free, including snooker and Taiwan 235. Enter Corner Pocket: World Billiards, aim freely, hold to build power and feel every shot. Challenge opponents or invite friends in seven distinct halls, using potting and cue-ball positioning to win.

apps.name: Crown of Sand
apps.short_description: Join the Crusades and forge your destiny in this historical narrative RPG. Become a knight, a man of faith or a powerful merchant. Choose between Saladin and Richard the Lionheart, face moral dilemmas, fight in battles and manage your own domain.

apps.name: Cutter: Nightshift
apps.short_description: Trapped on the night shift, June investigates the mysterious disappearance of a coworker in a dark, silent office building. Explore, solve puzzles, and face fear as something watches from the shadows. Cutter is an intense, atmospheric first-person psychological horror game.

apps.name: Dark Type On Tumour Humour
apps.short_description: ?Funny? Typing Game where you run through letters to type out jokes. Errors, Time, HIGH SCORE!

apps.name: Death Blonde
apps.short_description: Steamroll thousands of bio-mechanical creatures, die loud, and repeat. Death Blonde is a neon-soaked vehicular roguelite. Craft insane builds and survive a glowing wasteland that changes every run.

apps.name: Deluge: Raintime
apps.short_description: Certain things are better left alone, they don't willingly submit to the games of man, but develop a grudge, that sleeps under the soil for decades— An interactive visual novel with psychological and lovecraftian undertones.

apps.name: Demoman
apps.short_description: A 3D top-down arena survival roguelite where you blow up environments full of aliens to get your cat back. Your weapons orbit you and fire on their own, so your job is to move, survive and decide what your build becomes.

apps.name: Devils Flesh
apps.short_description: Devils Flesh is a survival horror, dungeon RPG where four characters are trapped deep below in the catacombs of a hopeless city. Old cults work in the dark and evil devils’ dwell, whether your character can escape this city alive without losing all of themselves depends on you.

apps.name: Dice Dice Battles
apps.short_description: A roguelike dice battler. Shop for strange dice, line them up, and unleash them on a cursed dungeon. Or pit them against other players in async PvP.

apps.name: Distance Travellers
apps.short_description: Fly, trade, mine and hunt bounties across a vast open galaxy. Haul cargo between stations for profit, take on bounty contracts, upgrade your gear and buy new ships in a single-player space sim where every long journey counts.

apps.name: Do Not Buy This Game
apps.short_description:
Are you really reading this to find out more? ...FINE!
If you DO buy this game, expect me to narrate in your ear for around 2 hours about your poor life choices,
all while I'll try to create something resembling a game for you to walk around in.

apps.name: Draemony
apps.short_description: A dark fantasy action RPG. Choose one of 8 classes, carve through a four-act campaign and an endless endgame of tiered Maps, chase loot, runes and uniques, and face the Xinoqs. Play solo or with up to 6 friends in online co-op.

apps.name: DRAVENHORT
apps.short_description: Lead your clan's survivors through a hostile, post-apocalyptic open world. Their lives depend on your decisions. Fight tactical battles, hunt, craft and build a settlement in a sandbox survival strategy RPG. Forge a House, face rival clans, form alliances and shoulder the burdens of regional power.

apps.name: Dry Jerky
apps.short_description:
You owe $100 in rent. You have $10. You have 5 days.

Dry Jerky is a survival RPG set in Oasis, a desert city with a rat problem, a shady snack industry, and a cast of characters you probably shouldn't trust. Find work, make questionable decisions, and try not to starve before the landlord shows up.

apps.name: Dub Party
apps.short_description: A dubbing party game where you and your friends turn any video clip into your own dub. Claim the roles, record every line in the booth, then watch the premiere together and save it. Play solo, pass one mic around on the couch, or go online with up to 8 players and five party games.

apps.name: Dust to Dust
apps.short_description: Fight for your afterlife in this colorful, action-packed 3D top-down Metroidvania-style game! As a ghost on the run in a specter research facility, sneak around interconnected levels, unlock new powers and team up with the local psychic to turn gigantic foes into dust.

apps.name: Echoes: A Transmissions Story
apps.short_description: Follow the transmissions of The Creator to guide a curious little robot across a vibrant and whimsical world. Explore, scrap, and craft your way through an emotional story of determination, self-discovery, and finding your place among the stars.

apps.name: Employees Only
apps.short_description: Clean and restock the aisles, unload new deliveries, manage inventory in the backrooms, work harder to grow Fluky profits. Never stop working from sunset to sunrise at Fluky!

apps.name: END US
apps.short_description: In this ruined world, nothing good happens at midnight. We fight, we hunt, we build. We tear from the earth whatever is left, just to buy a few more moments of life. You arrived here believing you were the only one. Maybe you were wrong. Would this be the last night?

apps.name: Evergain Adventure
apps.short_description: A fast paced 2D roguelite shooter where every weapon has its own passive and active ability. Fight through 3 distinct biomes, defeat bosses, and spend Emeralds on your ship to unlock new weapons, items and skills that make every run stronger.

apps.name: Fallen Gods
apps.short_description: Shape your own saga in a harsh world that changes every game, offering thousands of paths through hundreds of events. You are a fallen god fighting to win your way back home. Whether you prevail will depend on your might, wits, powers, followers, and artifacts—and, above all, on your decisions.

apps.name: Fantasy Cartographer
apps.short_description: Fantasy Cartographer is a relaxing game about creating maps with hand‑drawn graphics. Build lands filled with seas, mountains, and forests, gather resources, develop cities and kingdoms, discover new drawings, complete quests, gain experience, and become a master of cartography.

apps.name: Feranidus
apps.short_description: A top-down sandbox RPG where the creatures you raise change as you feed them. Hatch eggs, level your team, then chain elemental reactions in real-time fights. Explore, mine, loot, and theorycraft your party. Solo or online co-op.

apps.name: Field of Battle 1943
apps.short_description: Fight across land, sea, and air in a World War II first-person shooter set in the Pacific. Capture objectives as U.S. or Japanese forces with infantry, tanks, aircraft, and landing craft. Play online, on LAN, or solo with optional bots.

apps.name: Fishing Nooks: Beaver's Pond
apps.short_description: A painterly fishing game for people who just want to fish. Read the water, pick your lure and fight bass that fight back. No crops, no mines, no energy meter. Chill on the water. Hard on the hook.

apps.name: Flock Hunt
apps.short_description: A first-person stealth game about taking down mass surveillance cameras and fighting a dystopian future. Every camera you break brings The Flock a little closer. Sneak out at night and destroy cameras with a growing arsenal of tools, sell camera scrap for upgrades, and hire a crew.

apps.name: Followers of Krow
apps.short_description: Medieval Fantasy RPG Autobattler in a 3D Pixel Art style, where you buy and upgrade abilities to fight monsters and explore to uncover secrets about the world.

apps.name: Follyvale
apps.short_description: A wordless hidden-object puzzle game set inside living medieval paintings. Find what the villagers need, carry it across the scene and set their troubles right, and each one you mend brings the picture into full colour. No timers, no way to fail, and the Fool to help or sometimes get in your way.

apps.name: Fraggers
apps.short_description: Fraggers is a fast-paced, chaotic first-person arena "bomber" where grenades are your only weapons! Grab your powerups and blast your way to the top of the scoreboard! Bring your friends for explosive split-screen and LAN multiplayer mayhem!

apps.name: Fuck Everything 👉👌💦
apps.short_description: Your furniture is hot. Your AI sex doll is confused. And apparently, you have no idea what you're into. Explore your home, meet bizarre women, complete absurd quests, and discover your hidden desires in this wild adult adventure!

apps.name: Fugue's End
apps.short_description: A 2D fantasy turn-based strategy game centered on themes of freedom, and the exploitation of man. Gather those who have been cast aside, and lead them towards a new tomorrow. Now will you have what it takes to break your chains, and defy the divine? Perservere, and find out.

apps.name: FULL YET?
apps.short_description: Start with a tiny cup and bring a dry lake back to life! Carry water, unlock bigger containers and drive water-filled vehicles solo or with up to 3 friends. Work together—or knock your buddy over and spill their water. Every drop counts. Is it FULL YET?

apps.name: Furry Came-a-Lot
apps.short_description: Once upon a time, a horny knight tapped to the beat and came a lot. Conquer rhythm challenges to unlock 70+ uncensored furry videos and recruit sexy dancer bonuses in this lewd fairytale parody.

apps.name: Futanari Hell
apps.short_description: You're finally dead! 🥳 That would be bad news, but in Heaven women have penises 😇🍆 And so do they in Hell! 😈🔥 Fuck angels and demons and decide whether to go to Heaven or Hell 😇😈🍑☁️🔥

apps.name: Ghost Trap: Underworld
apps.short_description: John Ghost is back with a vengeance in this retro-metroidvania. But this time, he's going to hell. Explore the underworld, face its horrors, and fight to bring peace to the tortured souls of your loved ones.

apps.name: GidoGido
apps.short_description: Fuse with your friends into one giant kaiju you all control at once. Together, you're unstoppable! Pick a monster with its own special attack, then stomp through a fully destructible city and clash with rival kaiju in 4v4 party battles. Game nights are back!

apps.name: Gooning for Gold
apps.short_description: Your squat squad of 4 top tier ASSthletes are doing their best to achieve new personal records in all categories. Your role, as a hired hand, is to give these perfect figured beauties the competitive advantage they need.

apps.name: Goth Girls vs The Goo
apps.short_description: Run a cozy cybergoth colony where a small crew of goth girls builds, brews, DJs and hosts visitors from other worlds, while a slow, hungry slime ecosystem creeps in from the edges. Open portals, keep the Flux flowing, and find out what the Goo wants.

apps.name: Greenhouse: Dead Sun
apps.short_description: Greenhouse: Dead Sun is a action platformer metroidvania that takes you on a Journey through the worlds Northern Spire. After your 'friend' Calli was called to Northern Sprite you find yourself mysteriously right there with them- What does the Sun have in store for you?

apps.name: Grow a Girlfriend
apps.short_description: You accidentally grew a mushroom girl! Overcome your social anxiety to help her live her brief life to the fullest! Or don't.

apps.name: Guild Adventures
apps.short_description: You manage the guild.  The heroes fight.  Recruit new adventurers, send them into monster-filled lands for gold and loot, then improve your guild to push into more dangerous and rewarding challenges.

apps.name: Hamster Special Agent
apps.short_description: Hamster Special Agent is a 2-player co-op platformer! Become two chubby hamsters and work together to deliver cargo through seesaws, lifts, and spinning obstacles. Keep the crate from falling, reach the finish line together, and aim for a three-star clear!

apps.name: Haunted Attractions Inc.
apps.short_description: As the newest ghost manager of Haunted Attractions Inc., you'll build spooky theme parks, hire ghosts, and turn fright into fun in this cozy afterlife sim. One thing's for sure: you won't be bored to death here!

apps.name: Heartlands
apps.short_description:
A multiplayer sandbox where players create EVERYTHING. 
Design blocks, skins, sound effects, NPCs, and more! Place your creations in a live online world where every creation is player-made.

apps.name: Hidden Cats in Beijing
apps.short_description: Explore Beijing and find over 840 hidden objects, including cats and characters. Find Special Cats, unlock 7 bonus stages with two coloring modes, and collect cards featuring Beijing landmarks and real cats from our community.

apps.name: Hitchhiking to Hell
apps.short_description: A hitchhiking journey through empty roads where every car could be your salvation… or your end. Walk through desolate places and encounter bizarre strangers along the way. Talk, decide, and survive unpredictable encounters as rumors of a roadside killer spread. While travelling towards the unknown.

apps.name: Hook Her Up
apps.short_description: Weave a heart-shaped hook past divers, mermaids and monster girls, snag them all on the way up and send them flying into your boat. Sail from a sunny lagoon down to the abyss, beat every zone's queen on the line, and unlock each girl's uncensored animated scenes.

apps.name: Hopworth the Wizard
apps.short_description: Hopworth the Wizard is a challenging, colourful 2.5D platformer. A Gargoyle King has taken over Hopworth's Wizard tower while he was off questing. Journey home through forests, hills and mountain passes, leap the King's enchanted boulders and climb the tower to serve its eviction notice.

apps.name: Idle Game Dev Studio
apps.short_description: Run your own game studio in this idle management game. Develop and release games, automate the work, and turn your growing catalog into steady income. Give flops another chance, build sequels, then sell your studio for permanent bonuses and start again.

apps.name: Incremental Pain Profit
apps.short_description: Click, topple and profit! Knock over tiny wandering Humans, hire Animals to cause chaos, collect mountains of coins and grow your ridiculous empire. Unlock powerful Rebirth upgrades, defeat Bosses and turn a peaceful board into a glorious mess of falling people.

apps.name: Inside your hole
apps.short_description: Chaotic multiplayer mini golf for up to 8 friends: tornadoes, black holes, falling TNT and a course editor to build your own holes. Plus a co-op story mode where you get reincarnated as a mini golf ball.

apps.name: IntoTheLibrary
apps.short_description: Into the Library is a roguevania where you explore shifting dungeon themes, seal demons, and turn their powers into skills. Combine each character's unique abilities with equipment and artifacts to build your own playstyle and take on the next stage.

apps.name: Irregular Earnings
apps.short_description: Irregular Earnings is a multiplayer physics crime shooter. Three crews in suits fight over cash, briefcases and secret documents across one city. Trade, steal, cuff and shoot your way to the payout in a world where every body, bullet and car is simulated.

apps.name: Island Shuffle
apps.short_description: Build little islands, your way. Combine buildings and upgrades, enjoy colorful scenery, and watch your score grow.

apps.name: Isotopia
apps.short_description: A fast-paced first-person action game where you explore, fight, and destruct in a fully destructible voxel world, developing skills and uncovering the secrets of forgotten civilizations.

apps.name: Italian Street Food Simulator
apps.short_description: Run your own street food stand in a lively Italian coastal town. Prepare Italian street food, serve walk-up and seated customers, manage supplies and equipment and grow your business day by day in this first-person cooking simulator.

apps.name: It’s Table Time
apps.short_description: It’s Table Time is a cozy tabletop collection featuring classic board games, card puzzles, dice games, and casual arcades—from Chess and Ludo to Texas Hold'em and Tank Battles. Challenge smart AI solo or gather 2–4 players for couch multiplayer fun anytime!

apps.name: Jba Fofi
apps.short_description:
"My husband and I came across a huge eight-legged creature on a jungle trail in the Congo. It's been an hour since he got out of the car and went looking for the spider to photograph it...

Should I go look for him?"

apps.name: Just Beat It
apps.short_description: Weave through bullet patterns set to music. Use an invincible dash to break through danger, skim past bullets to score, and push for a better run in this single-player bullet hell action game.

apps.name: Kill A Million Zombies
apps.short_description: One city. One million zombies. Clear the streets in this incremental first-person shooter. Buy upgrades, watch your kill count climb, and keep going until it hits 1,000,000.

apps.name: Kisaragi
apps.short_description: A third-person shooter horror game inspired by the unsettling Japanese legend of the non-existent Kisaragi Station.

apps.name: Knights & Nonsense
apps.short_description: Knights of Nonsense is a social game with a mini RPG element to it. Run around with your friends using voice chat in a castle playing minigames, throwing tomatoes at who you hate most, role play, PVP and more.

apps.name: Last Couriers
apps.short_description: Dive into the post-apocalyptic Zone in this fun co-op extraction action! As fearless couriers, harvest anomalous hogweed, craft batteries, and power up teleports to proceed. But your loot attracts infected enemies you can't permanently kill... Сan you hold the line and escape in time?

apps.name: Leave It to the Ladies! ~ Sandwiched Between My Dorm Manager and My Boss~
apps.short_description:
You, a young salaryman, move to a company dorm alongside two older women: Kaho, the dorm manager, and Reina, your supervisor. As your relationship grows closer, things take an... interesting turn.
A rom-com visual novel where you're doted on, pursued, and fought over by two older women!

apps.name: Left for Clean
apps.short_description: Left for Clean is a cozy incremental game where you collect garbage, turn a trash-filled town into a tidy little place! Load your truck, and drive to the dump. Earn coins, unlock skill tree upgrades, and keep your tank fueled as you clean up the town.

apps.name: LetterZ: The Paths of Letters
apps.short_description: LetterZ: The Paths of Letters - is an automation game where you extract, transport, and assemble letters to form words. Optimize your production lines, unlock new possibilities, and build your factory, one letter at a time.

apps.name: Liminal Depths
apps.short_description: Liminal pixel horror in an endless place. Wake with no memory, keep the safehouse powered, take jobs from the terminal, and avoid what's waiting past the light. Recover who you are and escape before the Depths take you. Solo or local co-op.

apps.name: Logic Arrows
apps.short_description: Logic Arrows is a sandbox game where you design your own mechanisms: from logic gates to an entire computer. Use simple elements to build complex systems, solve engineering challenges and master computer logic.

apps.name: Lord of Kensai
apps.short_description: Command the seasons. Conquer rival factions. Build your legacy in the Katana-Ra universe. Lord of Kensai blends accessible city-building with deep, strategic mastery. Will your metropolis endure the shifting tides, or crumble under the weight of history? Ascend to power—your city awaits.

apps.name: Low Level Hunters
apps.short_description: Low Level Hunters is a low-poly, cold war era helicopter combat flight simulator. Pilot Cobra attack helicopter, Huey II utility helicopter, or MD-500 Defender by directly interacting with switches and control devices using mouse, joysticks, and VR controllers to defeat ruthless rebels!

apps.name: Lumen Keeper
apps.short_description: The swarm carries your base’s fuel. In this action roguelite with tower defense, build turrets by day and fight at night as a small robot. Kill enemies and bring back their Lumen to fuel the light. When fuel runs out, the fog eats away at your buildings.

apps.name: Materia
apps.short_description: Materia is a top-down sci-fi ARPG set in a vast, evolving galaxy. As a skilled Pilot, explore dangerous Rifts and Vaults, battle colossal World Bosses, and customize your character with the Cosmic Augmentation System. Team up or compete in PvP to shape the future of the Stellar Frontier.

apps.name: Math Combo Chain
apps.short_description: A tower defense where ammo is limited and math is your reload.

apps.name: MEATRASH
apps.short_description: In this city, implant contracts outlive their owners. In an underground processing facility, dissolve the "waste" delivered each morning and recover the implants buried inside. A first-person work sim. Deliver them for pay, or borrow a few for yourself and others?

apps.name: Mega Beast!
apps.short_description: A epic action arcade reverse horror arcade compilation

apps.name: Mercenary Galactic
apps.short_description: Synergize your fleet and fight your way toward the notorious Blackstar! Mercenary Galactic is a starship autobattler featuring rogue-lite elements and powerful fleet customization. Upgrade, recruit, and optimize your way through Velle and beyond.

apps.name: Metal Naval Combat
apps.short_description: The seas rose. One island still stands. Build a war factory from a single robot, automate your entire war economy, and hold the coast against saturation strikes of cruise missiles, drone swarms and ballistic warheads - then strike back across the sea with missiles, dropships and mechs.

apps.name: MimiCreate
apps.short_description: Even aliens have exams! In MimiCreate, Mimics must learn to hide among humans before earning a license to visit Earth. Build disguises, blend in, and dodge the Inspectors in chaotic multiplayer hide-and-seek.

apps.name: Minesweeper FPS
apps.short_description: Minesweeper, in first person. Step onto the board deep in dark, ancient ruins, read the glowing numbers, and dig with your pickaxe. Just don't hit the wrong block.

apps.name: Mini Mart Survivors
apps.short_description: Survive 10 minutes on the night shift at SHIFT24, where cup noodles, snacks, and coffee turn the aisles into a bullet heaven. Fight off nightmare customers, pay off your debt, and uncover what SHIFT24 is hiding in this survivors-like roguelite.

apps.name: Ministry of Order
apps.short_description: Inspect the parents’ medical record and match the newborn who can only be theirs — that is the day’s work in this 1920s dystopian puzzle. A fire burned the birth records, and the Ministry put you in charge of giving the children back. Your choice goes into the report.

apps.name: Money Laundering Raccoon
apps.short_description: A gang of raccoons have decided to start a money laundering business. There's just one problem: they misunderstood what "money laundering" actually means. Now they've got a laundromat, a suspicious amount of cash, and absolutely no idea what they're doing.

apps.name: Moon-Oriented Autonomous Biological Model
apps.short_description: When I was sunken in a deep depression, I set off on a journey.

apps.name: Moonberry Hollow
apps.short_description: There’s a place for you at Mallow’s picnic. Search ten painted woodland scenes for little lost treasures, from the rainy bakehouse to the lantern-lit stream, in a hidden-object story read by a gentle British narrator.

apps.name: Munchie Strikers
apps.short_description: A Group of ambitious jinn from antagonistic realms fight tooth and nail to snatch the ball, score against their opponents and determine who would become the ruler of the Earth.

apps.name: Murder Mystery Online
apps.short_description: A first-person 3D online murder mystery for you and your friends. Each player takes a role, walks the same crime scene, hunts for clues, and argues their way to the truth. Start with a free case. For paid episodes, one player buys and the whole group joins.

apps.name: Mushrooooooom
apps.short_description: A numerical incremental game about spreading spores. There are mushrooms aplenty here, giving you countless ways to take root and spread across procedurally generated planets. Cross the seas, burrow underground, climb into the clouds, and turn the entire map into your own color.

apps.name: Muv-Luv Girls Garden
apps.short_description: The latest Muv-Luv title, with over 800,000 copies sold worldwide! Become an amnesiac commander and lead girls piloting giant humanoid machines called "MGs" in this full-auto idle RPG. Explore the underground abyss known as the Maze and uncover the hidden truth behind the world.

apps.name: MyGame
apps.short_description:
这是一款第三人称俯视角动作射击游戏。你将扮演孤胆英雄，在无尽的敌人浪潮中浴血求生。
游戏核心循环简单爽快：击败敌人获取经验，升级即可从海量技能中随机解锁强力武器与天赋。通过不同的搭配，构建出独一无二的战斗流派，体验割草的快感。
除了局内的策略组合，你还可以通过局外养成系统永久提升角色属性，挑战更强大的关卡与 Boss。
游戏特色：
独特的第三人称镜头，战斗沉浸感十足
超 20 种技能与被动天赋，自由组合策略流派
丰富的局外养成，打造无敌角色
5不同难度的生存挑战
准备好在怪物中杀出一条血路了吗？

apps.name: Myriad: Radiant Frontlines
apps.short_description: Join Joan of Arc in a free desktop idle RPG. Collect heroines, build a team, farm gear and battle mythic bosses. Give gifts, grow closer and collect intimate artwork and private photos. Keep battles in a desktop corner, use a 25-minute focus timer, and play offline.

apps.name: Mystic Fog Maze
apps.short_description: A casual puzzle game where the player navigates through endless mazes surrounded by a mysterious fog.

apps.name: Nightclub Security
apps.short_description: In this absurd first-person bouncer game, you have 10 seconds to decide who gets into the club. Check IDs, catch drunks and hidden contraband, confiscate forbidden items, then let them in - or slap, shove, grab, and throw them out.

apps.name: Nimikins
apps.short_description: Nimikins is a cozy idle gacha game with zero microtransactions. Collect adorable Nimikins and discover rare, shimmering color variations as you reunite them with their goddess, Aerie. Craft accessories to grow their strength and express your unique personality.

apps.name: Nishin Difenda
apps.short_description: Defend the egg cell from ridiculous waves of sperm in a biological roguelite where antibodies, mucus, pH and chaotic upgrades become your weapons.

apps.name: Noa and the Bandits' Den
apps.short_description: A base of the worst nightmares. Try to escape before your soul is destroyed...

apps.name: NOSTRA
apps.short_description: A dark fantasy RPG where side-view party battles turn on timing: build Boost, raise a Ward, parry on the frame and break the guard. Loot rolls with affixes, sets and runewords. Three kingdoms hold a fragile peace while something older stirs. Play the alpha demo now.

apps.name: Oddballs Brawl
apps.short_description: Oddballs Brawl is a chaotic side-scrolling shooter for 2–4 players! Play as bizarre fighters, jumping, dodging, and blasting away across floating platforms and trap-filled arenas. Grab all kinds of weapons, send your friends flying, and fight for victory in the middle of the mayhem!

apps.name: OpSec Simulator
apps.short_description: Become the master of OpSec in town. Be careful, You may be caught! Balance your double life: do chores in the kitchen to keep her happy, sneak back to your room to run your PC ops, and manage your sleep before exhaustion blows your cover.

apps.name: Our Life: Now & Forever
apps.short_description: A paper airplane, two new neighbors, four autumns, and a one of a kind life. Create an experience that’s all your own in this near-fully customizable, choice-heavy story where you grow from childhood to adulthood.

apps.name: Panic Point
apps.short_description: Panic Point is a cooperative first-person psychological horror game where players explore hostile environments, manage limited resources, and work together under constant pressure. Survival depends on communication, teamwork, and staying calm when everything starts to go wrong.

apps.name: Pastel Squad
apps.short_description: Hold back the enemy horde swarming the city with a squad of cute girls! Build your team from 30+ unique members and fight with terrain and skills in real-time squad tactics. Includes three modes: Story, Missions and Roguelite.

apps.name: Pemkie Island
apps.short_description:
Pemkie Island is a monster taming RPG adventure, in a roguelite format.
Travel across the 5 different regions while discovering and taming unique creatures called Pemkies.
Master their traits, choose the right skills and build the best team possible to restore balance!

apps.name: Phineas and Ferb: New Inventions
apps.short_description: This time Phineas and Ferb decide not to fritter away their energy. They are going to build the coolest rollercoaster in their backyard! But to assemble such an enormous construction they need a good drawing and a lot of different parts which are not so easy to find.

apps.name: PLANETOON
apps.short_description: Grab planets, place them into orbit, and grow a galaxy in this space puzzle game. Watch life and civilizations emerge, encounter UFOs and black holes, and discover over 60 endings across 12 billion years of cosmic surprises.

apps.name: Planets in a Box
apps.short_description: Smash planets together in a real-time physics simulator. Watch a Mars-sized world hit the young Earth, debris spread into a disk and a new moon form, and tides stretch and spin up worlds. Up to 4 million particles on your GPU. Record the raw simulation data and replay from any angle at any speed.

apps.name: Play Pocket Manager
apps.short_description: A pocket-sized six-a-side football management game. Open packs, collect 260 players, pick your best six, and manage chemistry and formation across a full career of league seasons, cup runs and promotions. No adverts, no paid packs, no in-game purchases, and it plays entirely offline.

apps.name: Pocket Orbit
apps.short_description: Explore strange planets as a space cat. Choose a place to settle, deploy a habitat, gather resources and build your home by hand. Pilot your own ship, discover a Moon community, and make a life between adventures, alone or with a friend in co-op.

apps.name: POINT CLOUD
apps.short_description: A fast-paced, vector-inspired arcade shooter, set in a dark & minimalist galaxy. Blast through hoards of enemies, rack up high-scores, and collect new ships with unique abilities. Climb through the ranks and reclaim your identity.

apps.name: POP OUT!
apps.short_description: A simple and addictive real time strategy game.

apps.name: PRINCESS VANGUARD
apps.short_description: Control five elemental princesses, unleash spectacular Special Skills, and battle massive enemy hordes in this fast-paced 15-minute 2D top-down action RPG. Upgrade your weapons, defeat powerful bosses, and save the world!

apps.name: PrintMarket
apps.short_description: Build and manage your own 3D printing shop. Buy printers, load colorful filaments, produce and sell models, and reinvest in your workshop. Organize your space, manage electricity and materials, and grow from your first machine to an automated production line.

apps.name: Project Nebula
apps.short_description: An explosive arcade arena shooter inspired by the golden age of Amiga classics. Blast through asteroid fields, destroy alien forces, upgrade your ship, and unleash devastating weapons in a modern reimagining of a timeless genre.

apps.name: Protocol: Genesis
apps.short_description: A deadly infection has turned a medical crisis into a nightmare. Explore abandoned environments, scavenge for resources, battle the infected, and uncover the truth behind the outbreak in Protocol: Genesis, a story-driven survival horror experience.

apps.name: Purrfectly Sorted
apps.short_description: Sort over 4,000 adorable kitty plushies by patterns and colors onto shelves. In this relaxing first-person experience, earn money with every completed shelf and unlock handy upgrades to help with your task. Zero stress, just pure order and satisfaction.

apps.name: Quest for the Golden Nail
apps.short_description: One impossible pile. One Golden Nail. Pick, throw, sort and upgrade your way through a minimalist physics sandbox, cheered on by a boundlessly enthusiastic narrator. Find meaning among far too many ordinary things. No fuss, no fluff, no friends. Just you and way too many nails. How hard could it be?

apps.name: Re:act
apps.short_description: Every stone, every pane of ice, every turn lands on the beat, so the music tells you what’s coming. Crash, rewind, try again, until it clicks and you know it by heart. Every mode is a different way to answer the music. No note highway. The level is the song.

apps.name: Restitched
apps.short_description: Join Stuffy on a charming platforming adventure as they "restitch" unraveled communities. Unleash your creativity with a robust 2.5D level editor, play dress up with a powerful mix-and-match Wardrobe, and share your creations via Steam Workshop!

apps.name: Rhythm of the Backwaters
apps.short_description: A short cozy building and management sim set in the sleepy waterways of Kerala, India. A once-mighty village boat club is being revived decades later. Design and build a race-worthy boat, manage the club and its funds through its comeback season.

apps.name: Rock Paper Viking
apps.short_description: You are the sole defender of the Cardboard Castle! Pick up new weapons and magic abilities as you progress. Level up your loot to gain the strength of the Norse Gods, and defeat your foes to claim victory for your kin.

apps.name: Sails of Steel
apps.short_description: Become a modern privateer in a single-player naval action game set in the contested waters of near-future Southeast Asia. Work for states, syndicates or private forces, build your ship around its crew and command real-time battles where preparation and skill decide the outcome.

apps.name: SCROLLS: Tidy up the Library of Olympus!
apps.short_description: Restore order to a divine library by sorting 3,048 scattered scrolls, reuniting ancient collections, and unlocking powers worthy of Olympus. Read the markings, gather the volumes, and give the wisdom of the gods its rightful place in solo or with up to 8 players!

apps.name: Sender Unknown
apps.short_description: Work the night shift in an underground sorting facility. Weigh packages, compare their contents, and meet your quota by 6 AM. But beware, some packages hide dark secrets. Identify bad batches, earn cash, and survive the night in this tense PSX-style horror job simulator.

apps.name: Shards of Veyara
apps.short_description: Shards of Veyara is an adventure game that blends farming with 3D platformer action. Explore the sky islands of Veyara—a world warped across space and time—gather seeds and resources, cultivate crops in your hub to grow stronger, and reclaim the shattered Dimensional Shards!

apps.name: Shelves Full of Figures
apps.short_description: A room full of empty shelves and a floor full of little figures. Pick up each one, find the shelf where it belongs and put it back on! Earn ability points as you go and unlock new ways to move and sort in this relaxing first-person organizing game.

apps.name: Shipolis
apps.short_description: Shipolis is a cozy naval city builder and resource management game. Explore archipelagos with your ship. Build cities and expand in several regions. Manage production lines and automate with trading routes. Play at your own pace to build great wonders and uncover all the mysteries of the world.

apps.name: Shmandala
apps.short_description: Shmandala is a delirious arcade-style shoot'em up choreographed to a banging soundtrack!

apps.name: Shovel That Snow
apps.short_description: Hey neighbour! You arrived just in time. A blizzard has buried our neighborhood under some seriously thick powder, and we are all completely snowed-in our cabins. Just a typical Tuesday here in Scandinavia, right? Heh. Could you help us out?

apps.name: Sift & Shine
apps.short_description: A cozy life and job simulator where a dwarf leaves the mountain to build a new life by the river. Pan for gold, gems, and ores, collect cards, upgrade gear, pay bills, and raise a family.

apps.name: SkateFPS
apps.short_description:
When the system hates you, hate the system!
Experimental FPS about shooting magic from your hands with a skateboard + text adventure with multiple endings about being cursed in your own land.

apps.name: Ski Lodge: Tidy Up Together
apps.short_description: A blizzard closed the slopes and every guest dumped their gear in one giant heap in the middle of the ski shop. Climb a mountain of 2,000+ skis, boots, helmets and gloves and sort it all back onto the right racks – solo or with up to 5 friends.

apps.name: Somewhere Else
apps.short_description: A cozy 2-player co-op puzzle platformer. Play as Chimp and Chip on one couch or online with Remote Play Together, explore six strange and beautiful worlds, solve puzzles that need both of you, beat bosses and find your way back home.

apps.name: Spy Carnival
apps.short_description: Spy Carnival is a 2–10 player social deception game set in a chaotic funfair. Spies blend into a reactive crowd, sabotage rides and eliminate visitors. Security must read the crowd, follow witness tips and catch them before the carnival falls apart.

apps.name: Squadruped
apps.short_description: SQUADRUPED is a chaotic physics platformer where 2 to 4 players share control of a single four-legged robot. Coordinate your limbs, blast through physics obstacles, and try not to fall into the water on your way to the finish line.

apps.name: Swarm Queen: Reincarnated as Mankind's Doom
apps.short_description: Once an apothecary whose potions saved thousands, Elyse was branded a heretic and cast into slavery by a desperate Church. Falsely accused, she returns not as a savior, but as a ruthless conqueror. Now it's your turn! Evolve the swarm, command the horde, and crush humanity in this macro-free RTS!

apps.name: Tempered Hull
apps.short_description: Top-down tank shooter for 1–4 players. The Dominion took the valley; your brigade takes it back. Six upgradeable tanks, twelve voiced commanders, airstrikes and gunships, and six Dominion lieutenants between you and High Marshal Draeg.

apps.name: Ten Years of Rain
apps.short_description: Ten Years of Rain is a fantasy adventure Zelda-like with a unique Central Asian inspired setting. Pick up your blade, call your hawk, and prepare to travel the cursed lands. Battle the forces of the Great Khan, explore the secret places of the world, and discover the cause of the long rain...

apps.name: The Adventures Of Bryan Scott
apps.short_description: "The Adventures of Bryan Scott" is a classic 2D point-and-click adventure game, inspired by masterpieces like "Broken Sword" and "Deponia".

apps.name: The Bastion Protocol
apps.short_description: The Bastion Protocol is an idle tower defense game where a lone tower faces relentless enemy waves. Earn Entropy from kills, strengthen your build, and survive until your tower falls. Turn each run’s rewards into lasting upgrades and return stronger.

apps.name: The Far Off Up
apps.short_description: One balloon. A little curiosity. A long way up. Guide Ruby and Volly from a lively garden into the solar system in a playful climbing adventure. Collect curious stones, weather cosmic hazards, tackle relay challenges, and explore alone or together.

apps.name: The Fate of Onexora
apps.short_description: The Fate of Onexora is a turn-based, story rich fantasy RPG with a wide array of skills and equipment, allowing you to play in the style that suits you best. Follow the adventures of four heroes who have been unwittingly drawn into an impending catastrophe for which they are held responsible.

apps.name: The Further
apps.short_description: A co-op ghost-hunting horror game for 1 to 4 players, set in the 1970s. Drive your van to haunted houses, gather evidence with period gear, learn the entity's name over the radio and decide: drive it out or set the soul free. Every house, every entity is different.

apps.name: The Game Beneath
apps.short_description: Escape a collapsing dungeon in this fantasy solitaire card puzzle. Arrange cards in numerical order, overcome monsters and traps, and meet each row’s requirements. Choose from four classes, turn wildcards into tools or spells, and carry as much treasure as you can into the light.

apps.name: The Golfing Hour
apps.short_description: A realistic-that-turns-goofy Golf incremental game! Earn cash as you golf to buy powerful upgrades. Golf enough and you can turn pro, one step closer to becoming OVERPOWERED! Play with friends, launch your golf ball across different worlds, and see how far one swing can go!

apps.name: The Great Himalayan Noodle Descent
apps.short_description: Build a slide from the summit of Everest, all 29,031 feet of it, and send a pile of flailing noodles hurtling to the bottom. Bend, loop, and launch your way past cliffs and crevasses using real physics. How many noodles will survive the trip?

apps.name: THE HALLWAY
apps.short_description: THE HALLWAY is a chilling text-based, command-line psychological horror experience where every loop changes, your choices matter, and hidden secrets, puzzles, stats, multiple endings, and 20 Steam achievements await.

apps.name: The NAKI Files
apps.short_description: The NAKI Files is a first-person cooperative horror game where you awaken humanity and survive attacks from a deep state controlled by the alien Anunnaki, using knowledge, improvisation, and plenty of ammunition.

apps.name: The Short Hero's Honey Trap Dungeon
Theme Hospital™
apps.short_description: Design, maintain and manage a hi-tech hospital facility, making the most of limited resources and turning cures into cash. Can you balance the books and the bedpans?

apps.name: Throw A Life!
apps.short_description:
"Throw A Life!" is a chaotic party survival game for up to four players!
Work together to mine, craft, build, and hunt on a dangerous island.
Divide roles to survive efficiently—or embrace the chaos and have fun with friends!

apps.name: Tinsel versus the Naughty List
apps.short_description: Tinsel the elf has landed on the NAUGHTY LIST, and she's come to Santa's office to appeal. She swears she's innocent, but every snow globe of evidence tells a much NAUGHTIER story. A comedic, real-time 3D Interactive Erotic Story where you play Santa and decide her fate: Naughty or Nice?

apps.name: Tiny Fortress
apps.short_description: [Previously called "Tiny Towers"] A short incremental game about defending your tiny fortress from hordes of tiny mobs. Place towers, gain resources by defeating enemies, and unlock new upgrades in the skill tree to strengthen your goblin stronghold.

apps.name: TOO EZ!
apps.short_description:
An illustrated music video, and this time you play it! Aim with your mouse and click to the beat. That's it. New to rhythm games? Start with TOO EZ!
You can do it. TOO EZ!

apps.name: Torvane
apps.short_description: Torvane is a skill-based online melee team game for PC. Take a role as tank, DPS or healer, read your opponent and win the duel with timing and spacing. Server-authoritative netcode, no pay-to-win. Your first fighter is the Khaedr, a warrior from an original sci-fi honor culture.

apps.name: Tube Man Terry
apps.short_description: Survive being hunted by a 40-foot inflatable tube man and his brothers in a shut-down theme park for seven nights. Earn upgrades from the carnival crew, bolt weapons onto an old park tram, and begin your own hunt.

apps.name: Unboxed: Idle Case Tycoon
apps.short_description: Open cases, collect rare weapon skins, and build a fully automated skin business. Upgrade your auto-openers, fill your Vault, and outbid the bots in the Auction House. One more case. Always one more.

apps.name: Voxel Gambit
apps.short_description: Classic chess reborn as a 3D tactical RPG. Command unique pieces based on RPG classes across procedurally generated battlefields. Manage your action points, test your units' 'effort' and survive an adaptive AI on dynamic maps. The board has evolved.

apps.name: Watch Party: Watch the Web Together
apps.short_description: Watch Party is a 1–16 player online social hangout where you can watch videos and browse the web with friends or strangers. Join public rooms or create a private space. Stay synchronized or watch at your own pace. Play classic board games while you hang out together.

apps.name: Wayward Wind
apps.short_description:
A trading simulation traveling between cities to buy, sell, and profit from commodities in an ever-changing market, inspired by real-world commodity movements.
Turn market knowledge, timing, and a little luck into profit as you grow from an ordinary trader into a master of commerce.

apps.name: We Have a Gnome Problem
apps.short_description: Your toy shop has a gnome problem. In this cozy first-person tidying game, catch a whole shopful of runaway gnomes, toss the troublemakers and put every single one back on its proper shelf.

apps.name: Welcome, [Employee Name]
apps.short_description:
Welcome, [Employee Name]! You are our new space station controller. We trust you to make all the right decisions and keep the people of the HonkyTonk space station safe. Process as many trucks as possible but be careful, mistakes have consequences.
Welcome to the Honky Tonk Family!

apps.name: What Have I Become?
apps.short_description: Live an entire life through the personality you build. Every choice strengthens, weakens or transforms cards in your deck and that changes which choices become possible. Replay different lives, endings and identities, see what you became in your final Life Report. No correct answer has been filed.

apps.name: Wild Spirits Era
apps.short_description: Wild Spirits Era is a multiplayer PvPvE battle royale with roguelite progression. Up to 50 Spirits enter a new world for each 28-minute Era. Gather Vital Energy, build, fight and form alliances. Your actions shape your class. Only Spirits protected by a Relic endure when the world ends.

apps.name: Wing Commander™: 35th Anniversary Edition
apps.short_description: Wing Commander defined the space combat genre upon its release in 1990. Now celebrated in this special 35th Anniversary Edition, the game has been restored in collaboration with the dedicated Wing Commander community.

apps.name: Wireframe
apps.short_description: Stem the tide of endless hordes of enemies in a new, retro styled, and fast paced arcade shooter game. Buy upgrades, and earn the highest score you can through mastery of movement, precision, and endurance.

apps.name: Wizard School Dropout
apps.short_description: You left wizard school in disgrace, and now have only one option to pay off your student loans: crime. Wizard School Dropout is a magic-focused, turn-based RPG and wizard simulator featuring heavy environmental interactions and spell combinations for a wide variety of playstyles. Be Mage Do Crime!

apps.name: Wolfsbanner: Medieval Kingdom RPG
apps.short_description: Fight with a longsword in brutal third-person melee: block, shove, stun and finish armored foes in bloody executions. Then rule as king of a living 1403 Central European town you build stone by stone, in the same world, with no loading screen.

apps.name: X Marks the Orc
apps.short_description: An auto-battler roguelite. Call a play, mark who dies first, give each hero a job, then watch the fight unfold. Between fights, buy and merge units to grow your party.

apps.name: XDefense LF
apps.short_description: Your castle is under attack! Defend your walls with pets and magical creatures at your side across 200+ levels and unlock unique weapons and skills. Take on Challenge, Epic and Legendary modes, enjoy minigames, and face Peusk, the god of thunder, and Morttuks in two brutal final battles.

apps.name: XtreaM Zombies
apps.short_description: Survive escalating zombie waves in a top-down shooter, solo or with a friend in online co-op. Earn cash, collect loot and blueprints, and turn each purchase into a better chance of survival. Complete achievements to unlock cosmetics and rescue cats along the way.

apps.name: Zero Colour
apps.short_description: Crazy Eights reimagined as a roguelike deckbuilder. Chain cards by color and number, build huge combos and take down bosses with unique abilities. Five distinct decks, the Corruption Zone and quick runs that never play the same.

apps.name: ZOMBIE DESTROYER
apps.short_description: Just dodge. Your guns do the shooting. Quick, punchy runs, then toss your cells into the incinerator and watch the coins pour out.

apps.name: 世界防衛少女!!-DEFENDER MAIDEN-
apps.short_description: This is an action game featuring a mysterious girl who takes on hordes of monsters with her sword and bombs.

apps.name: 仙武三国
apps.short_description: 《仙武三国》是一款三国×修仙题材的买断制单机放置游戏。收名将、排兵布阵、攻城略地，在百世轮回中积累龙气，从乱世小卒一步步登临真龙天子。无内购、无强制联网，100 章完整主线。

apps.name: 修仙除魔传
apps.short_description: Start as a Qi Refining loose cultivator and forge your path to immortality. Fight with real-time movement, farm monsters on idle auto-hunt, jump in whenever you want.

apps.name: 夜航船
apps.short_description: 深夜的小巷，她从电台里走到了你面前，从那一刻起声音不再只是声音，它染上了温度，也变得更加沉重。你开始重新审视自己，他人，以及这座县城里被遗忘的烟火与孤独。这是一个关于倾听与理解的漫长航行，在无边的黑暗中，你与她一同探索，寻找那道或许并不存在的光。

apps.name: 懒得起名字
apps.short_description: Animal shape survivor game.

apps.name: 无基之谈2D
apps.short_description: Eggy, an otaku, wakes up one day to find himself transformed into a cute girl?! Ballshit 2D reimagines the original live-action story as a 2D visual novel. Follow Eggy through campus life, friendships, awkward romance, and absurd surprises, with new 2D art, CGs, and the original voice acting.

apps.name: 沦为萌犬-被姐姐们温柔偏爱
涂鸦学院
apps.short_description: A fantasy school auto-battler where you collect and fuse cards, combine hero, race, and class synergies, and build teams for battle.

apps.name: 王のレガシー
apps.short_description: "Kings Legacy" is a third-person action RPG where you control a beautiful heroine, enjoying simple action mechanics and a deep progression system to forge your own combat style. By transforming into a griffin, the protagonist can fly, allowing you to freely explore and enjoy your adventure.

apps.name: 走走小日
apps.short_description: Moments is a point to go adventure game where you can explore the land with two besties,  Mai and Shiro. There are tasks and puzzles that help Mai with solving her way through the adventure. She captures the cute creatures, Hibimon, which helps unlock important mysteries in the diary.

apps.name: 魔塔合集：新新魔塔、新新魔塔2、混沌幻想、纳可物语
apps.short_description: Explore 14 Mota dungeon adventures across 1,952 maps, including Xinxin, Xinxin 2, Chaos Fantasy and Neko. Plan routes, manage keys and gems, and compare battle costs. Play offline with separate saves, character choices and dungeon themes. Game content is primarily in Simplified Chinese.

apps.name: Billionth Soul Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Listen to the music of Billionth Soul, from Main Menu and First Thaw to Galactic Empire and Danger. Includes all 12 game music tracks as tagged MP3s, totaling approximately 22 minutes 45 seconds. Included with purchase of Billionth Soul at no additional cost.

apps.name: GOOB8 Soundtrack
apps.short_description:
The soundtrack to GOOB8!
This album includes all games OST + the OST of the launcher itself.
All songs are made by Seal Dice.

apps.name: Lies of P : Soundtrack
apps.short_description: 121 tracks of “Lies of P” and "Lies of P: Overture" OST.
